en.headline: Customs seize HK$50 million in counterfeit hard disks, arrest six in Tuen Mun
en.dek: Officers raided five industrial units and found about 6,800 suspected counterfeit disks plus 20,000 second-hand units awaiting processing.
body: Hong Kong Customs arrested six people on Thursday after raiding processing workshops and storage facilities in Tuen Mun linked to the production of suspected counterfeit hard disks.

Officers seized about 6,800 items of suspected counterfeit hard disks with an estimated market value of HK$50 million, along with packaging materials and tools. They also found approximately 20,000 second-hand hard disks believed to be awaiting processing.

The five men and one woman, aged 31 to 59, include five mainlanders and one local resident. Customs said the group purchased second-hand disks, removed original labels, formatted them with specialised equipment and affixed labels of major brands before packaging them for sale.
Some of the arrested persons are expected to appear in court on Friday. The investigation is continuing and further arrests have not been ruled out.

zh.headline: 海關屯門搞冒牌硬碟工場拘6人 檢值約5000萬貨
zh.dek: 關員搜查五個工廈單位，檢獲約6800個懷疑冒牌硬碟及2萬個待加工二手硬碟。
body: 香港海關周四在屯門突擊搜查涉嫌加工冒牌硬碟的工場及倉庫，拘捕六人。
行動中檢獲約6800個懷疑冒牌硬碟，估計市值約5000萬港元，另有包裝物料及工具。關員同時發現約2萬個相信有待加工的二手硬碟。
被捕的五男一女年齡介乎31至59歲，包括五名內地人及一名本地人。海關指集團購入二手硬碟後，用除臺劑移除原有標貼，以專用設備格式化，再貼上知名品牌標籤包裝出售。
部分被捕人預計周五提堂。調查仍在進行，不排除再有人被捕。
